metadata.description: Coding-agent rules, skills, and hooks for Agentic AI Tools repositories, one plugin per stack.

plugins.name: okf-design
plugins.description: Open Knowledge Format v0.3 design bundles: reading from indexes, authoring concepts, and a skill that checks frontmatter, index descriptions, and links.

plugins.name: org-core
plugins.description: Organization rules for every Agentic AI Tools repository: branching, pull requests, TDD, lint before commit, commit attribution, and secrets.

plugins.name: postgres-flyway
plugins.description: Schema repositories and modules that own a schema: Flyway naming, forward-only additive migrations, Postgres conventions, and the migrations image.

plugins.name: python-service
plugins.description: FastAPI services and lifecycle modules: the technology stack and design patterns, skills for endpoints, ports, and store queries, and a ruff hook on edited Python files.

plugins.name: react-portal
plugins.description: Portals and SPAs: the UI foundations and components standard, skills for pages and data tables, and an oxlint hook on edited files.

plugins.name: terraform-infra
plugins.description: Bootstrap and infrastructure repositories: module per shell, deployer-role scope, GitHub OIDC with immutable subjects, apply gates, and a terraform fmt hook.
